title: Shared savings widens from the same job built twice to the same principle missed elsewhere
ruling: Owner 23:26 CST Nov 13 (relayed by the consultant, 23:27; triage did not see it): his earlier suggestion (claim-at-merge for records) was applied narrowly; it applies conceptually to much more. Widen step shared-job-finder (ruling R29, owner 10:22 CST Nov 11, "shared savings"): besides the same job built twice, when a ruling, rule or guard lands, a judge asks where else that mistake class or principle applies across all repos, and files each find as a candidate step. Tonight's case: claim-at-merge covers records but not test section numbers. The consultant's wording of the add, not the owner's: part (3) in its message.
quote: big picture outcomes based my suggesiton here was applied narrowly when really it applies conceptually to so much like this — dont we have some judge that identifies opportunities like these as “shared savings” is what i coined it as?
source: Consultant message to triage 23:27 CST Nov 13 (relayed verbatim); filed by triage.
